hypothesis: Continued bounded feedback adaptation lowers post-change CE by at least 5% against frozen direction with same-state adaptive step magnitudes, without more than 2pp old-fact loss in any seed.
primary_metric: Per-seed equal mean of novel CE at steps544..768 every32 and drift CE at1056..1280 every32 (16 checkpoints); mean of three paired relative CE reductions.
minimum_useful_effect: Mean relative CE reduction >=5%, each seed >=0%.
success_rule: All finite/replay/numerical/magnitude gates, mean effect >=5%, no negative seed; candidate old-window and final-old accuracy no worse than control by >2pp in each seed.
futility_rule: No tuning or additional seeds. Stop on fidelity, preservation, pilot numerical failure or budget exhaustion. Main numerical failures are preserved by arm and invalidate the primary gate; no promotion on a failed retention/effect gate.

authorization.user_approval_reference: Latest user: Awesome, go ahead and continue to the next stage. Prior user: use the existing project folder or GitHub repo; use research scratch and minimize artifacts. Standing bounded CPU synthetic continuation and publication to own fork draft PR3.
authorization.approved_resources: Local CPU only, at most3 concurrent single-thread children; no GPU/cloud/paid service/external dataset. Restore the previously used torch2.14.1+cpu runtime in temporary local storage.
authorization.max_walltime: 15 minutes execution wall time; source/recovery/publication excluded
authorization.local_cpu_budget: 900 aggregate process CPU seconds including imports, verification, warmup, diagnostics, pilot/main full replay, launcher and analysis; child caps30+110+3*230=830 seconds plus at most one second hard-limit grace each.

design.mechanism_equations: RULE_MAPPING.md; unchanged preserved dense local equations, uniform feedback spectral cap2, per-hidden-layer norm matching of full SGD drive including decay at same current W/batch.

arms.backprop: Exact W updates, common W warmup. Unused warm feedback frozen.
arms.random_fixed: Original uncapped random feedback, common W warmup.
arms.frozen: Capped learned warmup feedback held fixed.
arms.adaptive: Capped learned feedback continues local updates.
arms.frozen_match_adaptive: Frozen feedback directions, per-layer drive norms from separate adaptive shadow following this own forward trajectory.
arms.adaptive_match_frozen: Adaptive feedback directions, per-layer drive norms from immutable warmup feedback evaluated at this own forward state.

design.control_rationale: Main control isolates policy magnitude at a common state from the frozen direction. Reciprocal control tests the reverse normalization. Trajectories may diverge; this is not exact trajectory, parameter-memory, FLOP or walltime matching.
design.seed_selection_method: Three fresh consecutive preregistered world seeds; independent separate pilot96977. No seed search or exclusion.
design.matching_track: Same forward architecture/start, data content, exposures, lr/decay, queries, replay and no tuning. Matched arms carry an extra feedback bank and perform two local calls.
design.compute_accounting: Lifecycle CPU incl shared4096-step BP+local warmup once per seed, full SVD caps, two local calls per matched update, diagnostic exact gradients and complete replay. Per-worker RSS is measured, not added to infer peak concurrent RSS.

data.dataset_versions: Deterministic synthetic threshold world generator: byte-preserved baseline_core.py make_data; no external dataset.
data.tokenizer_sha256: Not applicable: fixed11-dimensional numeric inputs and4 binary labels.
data.train_sha256: Generated before optimization from registered seed; canonical recursive SHA256 in each RESULT.json, regenerated and rehashed for replay.
data.selection_sha256: Not applicable: no configuration or checkpoint selection.
data.confirmation_sha256: Heldout queries are in canonical per-seed data hash; generated before optimization and never passed to policy_step.
data.split_boundaries: RNG offsets:61M world,62M old warmup,63M current stream,64M FIFO replay,65M heldout queries. Old contexts0..3; new4..5; phase2 flips context0 relations0/1; seventh ID unused.
data.research_wide_region_reuse_audit: Fresh world seeds701781..3 and pilot96977. Generator family and endpoint definitions reused from predecessor. No population transfer claim or official benchmark.
data.teacher_and_objective: No teacher; deterministic per-world labels and BCE-with-logits mean over batch and4 relations; stale replay labels remain historical.

training.updates: Each main seed:4096 common warmup +2048 stream updates per arm (512 per phase). Pilot4096+256 per arm.
training.target_exposures_per_trial: Main warmup1048576 binary targets, stream262144 per arm; pilot stream32768. Warmup shared across arms; full replay does not add training information.
training.tokens_per_update: No language tokens; warmup64x4 targets, online32x4.
training.bptt_length: Not applicable: feedforward model, no BPTT.
training.accessible_history: FIFO512 examples sampled before current batch appended; old initialization reservoir. Historical labels age out after32 batches.
training.state_carry_and_detach: W and B/V/U persistent; no optimizer state. All explicit updates detach/clone; separate shadow bank only in frozen_match_adaptive.
training.document_reset_policy: Not applicable: synthetic contexts, no documents.
training.optimizer_schedule: Fixed lr.05; feedback multiplier.8; WD W/B .001,V/U .01; spectral cap2 applied initially and after feedback update with margin1-4eps. No clipping of magnitude scales.
training.checkpoint_selection_rule: No selection: all prescribed windows and terminal state reported. States contain warmup and all final/last-finite matrices; all four phase hashes checked by replay.

execution.hardware: Local CPU; no GPU; exact platform in each RESULT.json.
execution.source_ownership_and_concurrent_writers: One implementation owner, no subagents. Three workers write distinct seed directories. Source/protocol committed and byte-verified in own fork before any experiment execution.

fidelity_tolerances.replay: Bitwise equality of all phase/final actual+shadow states; restored NPZ values bitwise equal.

execution.canary_matrix: Original baseline verify: exact transforms/dense rules/gradients/decay/causality; extension: cap and dense matched equations in both dtypes, mixed gates, nonzero states, no-autograd local paths, zero/unmatchable behavior, common W warmup bitwise. Pilot full warmup and all6 arms/replays.
execution.cost_estimate: Expected 300-600 aggregate CPU seconds; fixed hard cap budget830 plus launcher/analysis within900; max3 workers, no scaling up.

evaluation.primary_endpoint: Per-seed equal mean of novel CE at steps544..768 every32 and drift CE at1056..1280 every32 (16 checkpoints); mean of three paired relative CE reductions.
evaluation.duplicate_policy: Full deterministic online replay of all6 arms for pilot and each main seed, starting from serialized common warmup and regenerated/hash-verified stream. Phase/final and shadow-state hashes and saved final tensor equality required.
evaluation.uncertainty_method: Three paired seeds, report every result, mean and sample SD. Descriptive evidence only; no significance or population claim.
evaluation.multiple_comparison_policy: Only adaptive versus frozen_match_adaptive primary. Unmatched and reciprocal secondary; diagnostics descriptive; no choosing a favorable comparator.

deployment.batching: Training32 online/64 warmup; eval128 examples per6 contexts main.
deployment.prefill_decode_protocol: Not applicable: feedforward synthetic classifier; no deployment benchmark.
deployment.warmup_and_synchronization: 4096 shared BP+local warmup, one CPU thread; no asynchronous device.
deployment.memory_components: Report stored checkpoint bytes, coefficient counts and per-process ru_maxrss. Peak aggregate concurrency, activations and allocator breakdown unmeasured.
deployment.latency_statistics: Unmeasured: no deployment latency or efficiency claim; process CPU recorded for experimental cost.

evidence.checkpoint_manifest: Each seed RESULT.json states/hash fields and final ARTIFACT_MANIFEST.json
evidence.progress_path: pilot/<seed>/PROGRESS.json or main/<seed>/PROGRESS.json, replaced by immutable RESULT.json on completion
evidence.preservation_policy: Commit exact source/protocol/registry before execution; save compact JSON text in Git, four compressed STATES.npz individually in existing project Library folder, hashes/locators in artifact manifest. No cumulative archive. Failed evidence retained.
evidence.cleanup_receipt: TERMINAL.json cleanup: all child processes exited; temporary downloaded predecessor archive and restored runtime eligible for removal after durable state verification.

decision.reason: Evaluate frozen primary gate after all complete seeds and replay.
decision.next_experiment: If direction benefit remains but retention fails, separately test a fixed-budget replay-based retention intervention with matching controls; this protocol does not run it.

pilot.purpose: Full-warmup mechanical check only, no outcome tuning or selection; all arms must finish finite.
